izzyondroid:com.flasskamp.compete.name: Compete
izzyondroid:com.flasskamp.compete.description:
Compete is a fun-to-use app which helps creating challenges, invite friends, and compete against the public or in private. Higher, further, faster (and of course also lower, less, slower), or just anything that is measurable – create multiple disciplines, input your accomplishments and view automatically created rankings.
 ⚠️ Compete is a place where people can improve themselves in a positive way while having a lot of fun. Therefore, do not create or participate in challenges that violate applicable laws or general ethics, or have other unhealthy goals. Create challenges with several disciplines
 Your disciplines can be anything – let it be in the area of Sports, Health, Fun, Mindful, or Creative things
 Set a start date and how long the participants have time to accomplish the disciplines
 Invite friends or let the challenge be public (everybody on the same server can join)
 Get reminded on each discipline start to accomplish the current discipline
 People can look up other acomplishments from their challenges: videos, pictures, text, etc
 React to or comment on acomplishments
 Rankings are automatically updated after the discipline due date has expired
 Supports push notifications via UnifiedPush or ntfy
 Self-host the app server (configure for public, private, or user-invite access)
 Have fun!

izzyondroid:com.ki_bun.pioneer.name: Pioneer
izzyondroid:com.ki_bun.pioneer.description:
Pioneer is an open source tool to keep track of progress in an efficient way. Whether you are reading a book, .pdf, .epub, watching playlists, anime episodes, manga chapters, or anything else, Pioneer will act as one inventory to manage them, without relying on several different services for each.
 It is not just a tracker for watchlists, you can use it as a counter in general since it is optional to specify a maximum value, and also to keep track of a goal.
 Features:
 Material 3 dynamic theme
 Local and offline progress tracking, no accounts or internet connection required
 Adding, deleting, and editing progress
 Privacy focused progress tracking app with no data collection, analytics, and telemetery
 Optional description and maximum value
 Import and export to CSV
 Display tags and image
 Pioneer is a free and open source project licensed under GPL v3, view the source code at: https://github.com/ki-bun/Pioneer

izzyondroid:com.virtual_pen.name: Android Virtual Pen
izzyondroid:com.virtual_pen.summary: use your Android device to emulate a virtual pen on your PC
izzyondroid:com.virtual_pen.description:
Android Virtual Pen allows to send pen input data from your android device to a pc host where it emulates a virtual pen. What distinguishes this solution from others, is emphasis on low-latency to provide the best drawing experience.
 Features: 
 Adjustable pen pressure threshold such that you can move the pen-cursor without triggering an unintended click/draw action
 Adjustable pen pressure sensitivity such that you can customize the force needed to be applied
 Switch between stretched and fixed display mode In stretched mode, the android device screen is stretched and completely mapped to your PC primary screen. Note that this is required to fully reach the boundaries of your PC screen from your device but causes some slight distortion if the screen ratios (android vs PC) are not the same.
 In fixed mode, if the android device screen resolution fits into your PC screen, it is centered and mapped on that latter screen at a 1:1 ratio. This mode should incurr no distortion.
 Detect available usb devices and automatically save your settings for each
 Limitations: 
 Can only target one screen on the PC host (primary screen)
 Pen tilt is currently not supported (please do ask if you need this feature)
 No support on host side for MacOS and Windows

fdroid:com.aaronjwood.portauthority.name: Port Authority
fdroid:com.aaronjwood.portauthority.description:
A handy systems and security-focused tool, Port Authority is a very fast port
scanner. It also allows you to quickly discover hosts on your network and will
display useful network information about your device and other hosts.
One of the fastest port scanners with host discovery on the market! Host
discovery is typically performed in less than 5 seconds. If the device you're
scanning drops packets, it takes about 10 seconds to scan 1000 ports. If the
device you're scanning rejects packets, it takes less than 30 seconds to scan
all 65,535 ports!
 Features: 
* Heavily threaded, no more waiting for results one at a time
* LAN host discovery
* Public IP discovery
* MAC address vendor detection
* LAN/WAN host TCP port scanning
* Custom port range scans
* Open discovered HTTP(S) services to browser
* Lightweight service fingerprinting (SSH/HTTP(S) server type and version)
* DNS record lookups supporting almost every record type
* Wake-on-LAN for LAN hosts

fdroid:com.blackbox.app.name: BLACKBOX
fdroid:com.blackbox.app.description:
BLACKBOX is a clean, lightweight, offline-first security hub built for developers, creators, and anyone who values digital privacy. All data is encrypted with AES-256-GCM and stored on your device — nothing ever leaves without your explicit consent.
Core Modules:
- Secrets Manager: Store API keys, passwords, and tokens in categorized, encrypted vaults. Tap-to-reveal and one-tap copy.
- Encrypted Journal: Timestamped entries with category tags, all encrypted locally with your master PIN.
- 2FA / Authenticator: TOTP code generator with live countdown and manual secret entry. No cloud sync, no accounts needed.
- Privacy Tools: Permission audit, tracker URL cleaner, browser fingerprint viewer, and malicious URL scanner.
- Settings: Master PIN change, auto-lock timer, biometric unlock, panic mode with decoy calculator, screenshot blocking.
Security Features:
- AES-256-GCM encryption via Web Crypto API
- PBKDF2-SHA256 key derivation with 150,000 iterations
- FLAG_SECURE screenshot and screen recording blocking
- Biometric unlock (fingerprint / face) via Android BiometricPrompt
- Panic mode: calculator decoy triggered by PIN prefix
- Auto-lock on inactivity or app switch
- 100% offline — no network calls, no analytics, no tracking
BLACKBOX is free, open-source, and built with Capacitor for Android. No proprietary dependencies. No cloud. No compromises.

fdroid:com.mbosse.gymloga.name: GymLoga
fdroid:com.mbosse.gymloga.summary: Simple, native, and private workout logger for strength training.
fdroid:com.mbosse.gymloga.description:
GymLoga is a minimalist, native Android application for logging your strength training sessions.
Features:
- Fast logging with shorthand input (e.g., 135x5x3)
- Automatic Personal Record (PR) tracking
- Estimated 1RM calculations
- Exercise history and progress tracking
- 100% private: all data stays on your device
- Open source and free from tracking or ads
Inspired by the simplicity of a paper log but enhanced with the power of native Android.

fdroid:com.simonramstedt.yoke.name: Yoke
fdroid:com.simonramstedt.yoke.description:
Yoke connects to a Linux computer via network (Wifi / Bluetooth / USB). It
will be recognized as a normal Joystick/Gamepad by Linux, so it can be used
as a game controller.
The Linux client can be installed from https://github.com/rmst/yoke
Yoke currently supports 6 axes:
* Accelerometer X, Y
* Left thumbstick X, Y
* Right thumbstick X, Y

fdroid:com.studio4plus.homerplayer2.name: Homer Audio Player for Seniors
fdroid:com.studio4plus.homerplayer2.summary: Audiobooks and podcasts: simple player managed by a caregiver
fdroid:com.studio4plus.homerplayer2.description:
Audiobook and podcast player built for seniors, visually impaired and non-tech-savvy listeners who need an easy way to play audio. Instead of complex menus and unnecessary features, Homer offers a clear, minimal interface focused on one thing: easy audiobook and podcast playback.
Use the special "lockdown mode" to turn an Android tablet into a dedicated, single-purpose audiobook and podcast device.
Designed for:
- Elderly who want simple, independent listening
- Visually impaired users who benefit from large controls and spoken titles
- Non-tech-savvy users who find standard apps overwhelming
- People with cognitive challenges who need basic functionality
Easy to use:
- Large, easy-to-tap buttons
- Simple navigation with swipe left/right
- Flat content structure (no deep nested folders)
- No ads, no pop-ups, no distracting clutter
- Optional title read-aloud for accessibility
- Flip-to-stop: place device screen-down to pause playback
Lockdown mode:
- only playback functionality
- blocks exiting the app
- hides settings
- no access to other apps, notifications nor settings
Audiobooks:
- Play DRM-free audiobooks from device storage
- Resume position saved separately for each book
Podcasts:
- Automatically updates to show the latest 1-5 episodes
- Downloads full episodes for reliable offline playback
Caregiver-managed setup (secondary role):
- A caregiver configures content and settings in advance
- Optional lockdown mode hides all apps and functionality except the player
- Device is prepared once, then used independently by the listener
Additional features:
- High-contrast light and dark themes
- Customizable controls: volume, chapter skip, forward, rewind
- Adjustable playback speed
- Sleep timer with shake-to-continue
How it works:
1. Install Homer on an Android 7+ phone or tablet.
2. Add audiobooks/podcasts and adjust the interface as needed.
3. Optionally lock or hide settings.
4. Hand the device to the listener for simple, independent daily use.
Homer makes audiobook and podcast listening accessible for people who cannot comfortably use standard smartphone apps.

fdroid:fr.onyx.lyon1.name: Onyx
fdroid:fr.onyx.lyon1.summary: Your new app to guide you around La Doua Campus
fdroid:fr.onyx.lyon1.description:
All the Lyon 1 services you need on a daily basis, in a lightweight, modern cross-platform application.

fdroid:io.gitlab.coolreader_ng.lxreader..name: LxReader
fdroid:io.gitlab.coolreader_ng.lxreader..description:
Open source e-book reader for Android.
 Supported e-book formats through the use of the crengine-ng library: fb2, fb3 (incomplete), epub (non-DRM), doc, docx, odt, rtf, pdb, mobi (non-DRM), txt, html, Markdown, chm, tcr.
 Main features:
 Most complete support for FB2 - styles, tables, footnotes at the bottom of the page
 Extensive font rendering capabilities: use of ligatures, kerning, hinting option selection, floating punctuation, simultaneous use of several fonts, including fallback fonts
 Word hyphenation using hyphenation dictionaries
 Ability to display 2 pages at the same time
 Displaying and Navigating Book Contents
 Ability to use bookmarks
 Reading books directly from a ZIP archive
 TXT auto reformat, automatic encoding recognition
 Flexible styling with CSS files
 Background pictures, textures, or solid background
 Animation of turning pages - like in a paper book or simple shift
 Customizable actions for touch screen zones
 View illustrations with scrolling and zooming - by long pressing on the illustration
 Select text and send it either to the clipboard or to another application, etc.
 Reading aloud with the possibility of using accent dictionary
 Built-in book library with search and/or filtering
 Simple built-in file manager for viewing the list of files on the device

to geo-coordinate which can be
 opened in a map or navigation app such as OsmAnd, Maps.me, APhotoManager.

fdroid:org.billthefarmer.solver.name: WordleSolver
fdroid:org.billthefarmer.solver.description:
* Multiple coloured themes
 * Multiple languages
Usually solves Wordle and Gurgle puzzles in four tries.
Uses solver code from https://github.com/PoorLazyCoder/Wordle-Solver .
Letters that are shown green in the puzzle ( Wordle , Gurgle ) go in the first green row in the correct place. Yellow letters go in the next yellow rows in the correct place. Letters shown grey go in the last row in any order.
Tap either the next button on the keyboard or the solve button in the toolbar. The next button only works if there is text where the cursor is, so it can be used to move to the next slot without triggering a search. The app will show a list of possible next guesses at the bottom.

fdroid:org.juanro.autumandu.name: Autu Mandu
fdroid:org.juanro.autumandu.summary: Autu Mandu allows you to control the income and expenses of your vehicles.
fdroid:org.juanro.autumandu.description:
Autu Mandu is an android application based on the discontinued Car Report with some new options that allows you to enter refueling and other income and expenses of your vehicles in addition to displaying nice reports.
You can add mileage and time based reminders for recurring car related actions, e.g. general inspection once a year.
It offers synchronization with webdav and has basic backup/restore and CSV import/export functions.

fdroid:org.mattvchandler.a2050.summary: A game loosely based on 2048, but with circles instead of squares
fdroid:org.mattvchandler.a2050.description:
Much like the original, you start with small numbered pieces and combine
like-numbered pieces into progressively larger ones, working toward 2048.
Unlike the original, the pieces are free to move in any direction, bounce off of
the walls and each other, are subject to gravity, and grow progressively larger.

apple-macos:6777684340.name: Cloudbreak Weather
apple-macos:6777684340.description:
Cloudbreak is a fast, private weather app for people who actually watch the sky — built with a fire-weather edge for anyone living in or near wildfire country.
Open it and you get a clean, honest read on right now: current conditions, an hourly strip you can scan at a glance, and a seven-day outlook — sourced from the U.S. National Weather Service and, in Canada, Environment and Climate Change Canada. Tap any detail for a 24-hour chart of humidity, wind, pressure, UV, visibility, and more, or drag the sun along its arc to see exactly how much daylight is left.
Where Cloudbreak goes further is fire and air:
• Fire-weather risk — the day's expected max, from Low to Extreme, with the official drivers (humidity, wind, Haines index) and a 48-hour outlook, so an elevated day never catches you off guard. Official NWS data in the U.S.; a clearly-labeled modeled estimate anywhere else. Each day in the 7-day forecast is flagged for its peak fire risk, too.
• A dedicated fire map — active incidents and perimeters, satellite hotspots, smoke, and historical burn scars (official USGS/USFS records for major fires), each a layer you can turn on or off, with a tap-through detail on every feature.
• Smoke and air quality — live AQI with a multi-day outlook, plus NOAA smoke plumes on the map, so you know when to keep the windows shut.
• National Weather Service and Environment Canada alerts — the most severe warning for your area, front and center.
Explore the weather visually: play NEXRAD radar forward past now with a short-range forecast, loop GOES GeoColor satellite imagery, read surface wind and temperature fields, and add lightning or air-quality overlays on top — with active-fire hotspots available over any of them.
Have your own hardware? Connect a personal weather station — Ambient Weather, Tempest, Davis, Netatmo, or PWSWeather — and Cloudbreak blends your backyard readings into the forecast. (Newer providers are marked Beta in the app.)
Cloudbreak comes with an Apple Watch app, Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, and a native Mac app, so the forecast is wherever you are.
Private by design
We don't run servers that store your data, and there are no accounts to create. Your location is sent to public weather and fire-data providers only to fetch a forecast — it is never stored by us, never tied to your name, and never used to build a profile. No ads. No analytics. No third-party tracking. The keys for any station you connect are kept in the Keychain and reach your other devices only through iCloud Keychain.
Full guide, FAQ, and support: apps.stonemesastudio.com
Fire-weather, smoke, and air-quality information is for general awareness — always follow official guidance from local authorities in an emergency.

apple-macos:6761675450.name: Primuse: Self-Hosted Music
apple-macos:6761675450.description:
Help choose the Primuse app icon
Submit a design of your own, or vote for the icon you’d like on your Home Screen.
https://palveni.com/en/funbox/primuse-icon-vote
Bring the records on your phone, NAS and cloud drives into one library. Listen to an album without gaps at home, pick up your audiobook in CarPlay, or turn down the vocals on a favorite track and sing along.
Your files, servers and cloud drives
Queue a local track alongside an album on your NAS and a live recording on a cloud drive. Connect compatible music servers, Synology, QNAP or ZSpace storage, and cloud drives including Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox and 115. Browse shared folders over SMB, WebDAV, FTP/SFTP, NFS, S3 or UPnP/DLNA. Stream on demand or download music with its artwork and lyrics for offline listening. Choose which sources to use on each device.
Sound and formats
Play FLAC, ALAC, WAV, AIFF, APE, WavPack, DSD, DTS, MP3, AAC and more. Browse single-file albums by track with CUE sheets, open SACD or DVD-Audio images, and read track names and ReplayGain from matching SACD Metabase XML files. Use gapless playback for a live album or crossfade a playlist. Calibrate headphones or speakers with an AutoEQ curve measured for your model. Reconnecting the device recalls its profile. Adjust EQ and reverb, or use DoP with a compatible DAC.
Lyrics, artwork and karaoke
Follow line- or word-synced lyrics, translations and duet parts. Choose which embedded lyrics to use, find lyrics online, or set the timing yourself as a song plays. Save the result inside a supported file or alongside it. Give albums video covers and switch between vinyl, cover walls and music-reactive visuals.
On supported tracks, turn down the original vocals, switch to the instrumental, change key, loop a difficult line, score your singing or record it. Sing Along is unavailable for tracks played by the system music player. Optional on-device AI vocal separation requires iOS/iPadOS 26.4 or later and a model download. Medleys let you sample tracks and return to a full song.
Rediscover your collection
Browse by artist, album, genre or folder, or search for a line you remember from a song. Group same-title albums across sources. Build a smart playlist for rock tracks you haven’t played in a month and let it change as you listen.
Edit titles in batches, correct artist names or covers, and save changes to supported sources. Choose which duplicate to keep while preserving files on read-only sources. Revisit your most-played albums in your listening charts and year in review.
Books, podcasts and radio
Connect your own audiobook server or play your M4B files. Keep chapters, bookmarks, narration speed, a sleep timer and your place in each book. Browse podcast shows, save favorite episodes and follow searchable transcripts when available. Add stations by stream URL or subscribe to M3U or PLS lists. Organize stations in folders and see the current track when the broadcaster provides it.
On iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and CarPlay
Give the player its own bass-reactive background or fill the Lock Screen with artwork. Choose music and adjust audiobook speed in CarPlay. See lyrics, change tracks and browse the queue on your watch. Use Siri, Spotlight, widgets, Control Center and AirPlay, or share lyrics as an image, video or Live Photo.
Sync and discovery
Sync supported playlists, sources and preferences with iCloud. Send music, lyrics and artwork over your local network. Restore your recent music queue with its order and position, see your most-played tracks and choose how long a song must play to count as a listen. Optional AI tools offer semantic search, translation and transcription. Online transcription sends audio only with your consent.
Official website · https://palveni.com
Guides and answers · https://palveni.com/en/knowledge?product=primuse

apple-macos:411680127.name: WiFi Scanner
apple-macos:411680127.description:
Boost Your Connection: Scan, Diagnose, and Fix Slow WiFi with Ease! Supports all WiFi technologies, including WiFi 6, WiFi 6E, and WiFi 7 (802.11be) networks.
Whether you are a professional looking for advanced technical information, a homeowner with a new WiFi setup or a student gathering information for a school project, WiFi Scanner is great to have handy. With WiFi Scanner you can scan and monitor signals in the air and see what wireless networks are around. Then run speed tests on any wireless network and view detailed information about its signal levels, channel width, encryption type, noise level and much more!
WiFi Scanner is fast, lightweight and easy to set up. See the review below from MacWorld.
"...your wireless router is fighting for spectrum with its neighbors, potentially slowing you down and making your Internet experience less pleasurable. ...WiFi Scanner helps you solve this problem by showing you all the access point(s) nearby, and suggesting the best configuration settings to get the most out of your router." -- MacWorld
WiFi Scanner is great for determining the best position for an access point at home or in the office. Once placed, the optimal channel can be found by picking the least used one, resulting in improved WiFi speeds.
10 languages now supported: English, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese.
Key Features
- Simple, fast wireless network discovery of 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be access points
- Full support for 2.4, 5 and 6 GHz networks
- Support for all channel bandwidths (20, 40, 80, 160 and 320 MHz)
- See which channels actually overlap, counting every channel a radio covers rather than only the one it advertises
- Display detailed wireless network parameters: network name (SSID), signal level (RSSI), MAC address (BSSID), signal quality, channel, maximum data rate, encryption, WiFi generation and more
- Display changes in signal level over time in graphical form
- Filter detected networks by typing an expression, such as rssi >= -70 AND band == 5
- Group networks by access point, AP name, SSID, band, vendor, channel width, security or signal
- Give each access point a custom label
- Alerts that tell you when a network appears, a signal drops or a new BSSID joins your SSID
- Export results to comma separated value (CSV) files
WiFi Speed Testing
- Upload and download WiFi speed testing
- Test against public servers or against another Mac on your own network
- Auto run speed test when client roams to different access point
- Auto repeat speed test with wait time between tests
"Who's On My Network" (LAN Scanner)
- Fast IP scanner that detects unknown devices connected to your WiFi network
- Detects hostnames, determines the MAC address, and in many cases auto-detects device type (phone, laptop, router, etc.)
- Name any device yourself, and that name is what it is called from then on, surviving rescans and restarts
- Probe for open ports and services to identify the devices that stay quiet
- Scanning results can be saved to CSV or PDF via the export menu
- Great for finding WiFi "Piggybackers"
Advanced Features (supported by some access points)
- Display access point name if configured by network administrator
- Display number of devices connected to each access point
- Display channel utilization
- Display if 802.11r is enabled and type
- Display if WiFi protection mechanisms are enabled
- Full decode of the information elements a beacon carries, including vendor-specific ones
WiFi Scanner is a great tool for personal use and for IT professionals. Requires macOS 13 Ventura or later, and is fully supported on macOS 26 Tahoe. Use WiFi Scanner to find WiFi dead zones and select the best configuration for your WiFi access point / router to prevent video buffering.
For questions, feature requests, or support please email support@accessagility.com

firefox-addons:2299025.name: Snowflake
firefox-addons:2299025.summary: Help people in censored countries access the Internet without restrictions. Once you install and enable the extension, wait for the snowflake icon to turn green, this means a censored user is connecting through your extension to access the Internet!
firefox-addons:2299025.description:
Help people in censored countries bypass censorship by running the Snowflake extension 
If you want to help people in censored countries access the Internet without restrictions, consider installing and running the Snowflake extension. Once you install it and enable it, there's nothing else you need to do. Once the snowflake icon turns green, this means a censored user is connecting through your extension to access the Internet!
The only prerequisite to install this extension is that the Internet in your country is not heavily censored already.
There is no need to worry about which websites people are accessing through your Snowflake extension. Their visible browsing IP address will match their Tor exit node, not yours (since you're an entrypoint).
 If you live in a censored country 
If you live in a censored country and want to connect to a Snowflake extension, you do not need to install a separate application to connect to a Snowflake proxy and bypass censorship. It is a circumvention feature embedded within existing apps. Currently Snowflake is available inside Tor Browser on Desktop and Android, Onion Browser on iOS, and Orbot on Android and iOS. If you have downloaded and installed any of these apps, and they are censored in your country, you can bypass the censorship by activating Snowflake through these apps' settings page.
 Support channels 
If you encounter issues while trying to connect to Tor using Snowflake, the Tor support channel can be reached on Telegram and email (frontdesk@torproject.org). You can also browse the Tor Support Portal and the Tor Project Forum for answers.

firefox-addons:3028095.description:
Take full control over your browser's look with Theme Customizer - for Firefox!
Whether you prefer a sleek dark mode, a vibrant colorful setup, or a clean minimalist design, this extension lets you mix and match colors for your browser interface in just a few clicks. No design skills or coding required—just pick your colors and enjoy a personalized browsing experience.
Key Features:
• ✨ Full Interface Customization: Instantly change the colors of your browser frame (top bar), toolbars, tabs, and active window areas.
• 🎨 Smart Color Pickers: Use intuitive color wheels to find your favorite shades or enter exact RGB values for maximum precision.
• ⚡ Quick Contrast Buttons: Swap text colors between pure white and solid black instantly to ensure perfect readability.
• ↩️ Design History (Undo): Made a mistake? Quickly reload your previous design with the "Load Last Design" feature.
• 🗑️ Safe One-Click Reset: Want a fresh start? Instantly restore the original Firefox default theme anytime.
• 💾 Persistent Storage: Your custom creations are saved automatically and reload instantly whenever you restart Firefox.
How to use:
1. Click the Theme Customizer icon in your toolbar.
2. Select your desired colors for the Frame, Toolbar, and Text.
3. Click Apply Design to see the changes instantly.
Note: This extension respects your privacy. All your themes and preferences are stored locally on your device and are never shared or sent to any servers.

bluejetty:00041457:ios.name: Omega Royale - Tower Defense
bluejetty:00041457:ios.summary:
Merge towers. Build your defense. Compete in real-time tower defense strategy battles.
Omega Royale delivers a fresh twist on tower defense gameplay by combining real-time PvP battles, deep strategy, and merge mechanics. Outsmart opponents
bluejetty:00041457:ios.description:
Merge towers. Build your defense. Compete in real-time tower defense strategy battles.
Omega Royale delivers a fresh twist on tower defense gameplay by combining real-time PvP battles, deep strategy, and merge mechanics. Outsmart opponents, evolve your base, and rise to the top of the global leaderboard.
Whether you’re new to tower defense or a seasoned strategist, Omega Royale offers fast-paced, rewarding gameplay that evolves every match.
KEY FEATURES:
Real-Time Merge Tower Defense
- Place, merge, and upgrade towers on the fly
- Combine matching towers to unlock powerful effects
- Balance attack power, range, and spell casting to control the battlefield
PvP Strategy Battles
- Battle players worldwide in real-time, competitive matches
- Outsmart and eliminate up to 9 rivals in each round
- Climb the leaderboard in ranked leagues and seasonal events
Endless Replayability
- Each match is different: adapt your strategy as the battlefield evolves
- Experiment with tower types, hero powers, and spell synergies
- Upgrade your arsenal to gain a tactical edge
Game Modes for All Players
- Real-time PvP (1v1 and 10-player elimination)
- PvE wave defense for solo and practice
- Limited-time events and seasonal challenges
- Clan support and co-op play
Deep Progression and Customization
- Unlock a variety of towers with unique abilities
- Upgrade towers and spells with earned or collected resources
- Customize your loadout to fit your preferred playstyle
- Compete in seasonal events to earn exclusive skins and rewards
Omega Royale blends tower defense, merging, and PvP strategy into a thrilling, competitive mobile game. Whether you're chasing the leaderboard or just want a quick, tactical battle, this is the tower game you've been waiting for.
Why Players Love Omega Royale:
- Fast-paced matches with deep tactical decisions
- Merge mechanics add excitement and unpredictability
- High replay value with new strategies each game
- Competitive but fair PvP environment
- Visually striking arenas and effects
- Balanced for both casual players and strategy veterans
Join thousands of players worldwide. Build, merge, and battle your way to victory.
Download Omega Royale today and become a master of merge tower defense.

bluejetty:00024561:ios.name: NZBClient for NZBGet
bluejetty:00024561:ios.summary:
Use NZBClient to manage your NZBGet Server on your iPhone or iPad. This app works as a client or front-end for your NZBGet server v13+. Monitor, delete and edit current downloads and items in your history.
Including support for multiple ser
bluejetty:00024561:ios.description:
Use NZBClient to manage your NZBGet Server on your iPhone or iPad. This app works as a client or front-end for your NZBGet server v13+. Monitor, delete and edit current downloads and items in your history.
Including support for multiple servers with fast switching, great for local/remote access setups.
Search or Browse Newznab based servers for new NZB's, then fetch or save them. Create custom searches then automatically search and fetch results.
Get push notifications from NZBGet or any other service, when new NZB's are added to queue, deleted, fail, or downloaded.
With custom settings and menus you can fully customisable the app to suit your needs.
Features include:
 - Search, Browse & Fetch from Newznab servers,
 - Pause, Resume downloads
 - Push Notifications
 - E2E Encrypted Push Notifications 
 - Delete history or active downloads
 - Upload .NZB files
 - Multiple Servers
 - HTTPS/SSL
 - Set Speed limit
 - Pause queue for set time,
 - Set Category when uploading
 - Set Priority when uploading
 - Add to top when uploading
 - Add paused when uploading
 - Change priority of NZB in queue,
 - Change category of NZB in Queue,
 - Pause resume single NZB file in queue,
 - Save NZB files locally on device
 - Re-upload local NZB files
 - Set Default server
 - View History
 - View Log files
 - Edit and delete Servers
 - Set Refresh time
 - See detailed overview of each active download
 - Mark History items as good/bad
 - Re-download and Re-Postprocess history items
 - View Hidden items in history
 - View server log
 - Open and Uncompress .zip files
 - Group upload NZB files
 - Set unpack password
 - RSS fetching
 - Search and filter Downloads and History
 - Full App customisation
Note: Some features require a one-time in-app purchase or a monthly/yearly subscription to use, this helps support independent development.
You need to have a Laptop, NAS or PC running NZBGet v13+ to use this app.
NZBClient is a free download and offers a limited feature set for free forever! If you would like to unlock the full potential of the app and support independent development, you can purchase a one-time purchase of Premium to access some extra features, or subscribe (monthly or yearly) to Ultra to access all features.
NZBClient has monthly and yearly subscription options available that unlock all features. Subscriptions can be canceled at any time at least 24 hours before the next billing cycle.
Privacy policy: https://nzbclient.app/privacy
Terms of use: https://nzbclient.app/terms

bluejetty:00036098:ios.description:
Easily manage your health care benefit plans and expenses.
The Fidelity Health® app was built to help you minimize the time, cost, and hassle of managing your health care needs. It can help you manage your benefit plans and accounts if you’re enrolled in an employer-sponsored health benefits plan through Fidelity or if you have a Fidelity Health Savings Account (HSA).
With Fidelity Health, you can:
Access key info about your coverage and benefits
· See all your health plan coverage and benefit details
· Save and share pictures of your health benefit, prescription, and vaccination ID cards for easy access anywhere
Manage your health care expenses
· See your Fidelity HSA balances and transaction history, or balances for certain flexible spending accounts (FSAs)
· Reimburse yourself from your Fidelity HSA or FSAs for qualified medical expenses you paid out-of-pocket
· Pay your providers directly from your Fidelity HSA, brokerage or cash management accounts, FSAs, or personal bank accounts
· Scan a bill, so it’s easier to pay for health care expenses using your Fidelity HSA, brokerage, or cash management accounts
· Take advantage of your Fidelity HSA on the go by making one-time, tax-deductible contributions from your Fidelity brokerage or cash management accounts, or linked bank accounts
· Upload and save receipts for health care expenses 
· Link an external bank account to your Fidelity HSA in real time so you can make a one-time contribution
· Track activity across your accounts, including the status of payments, reimbursements, contributions, and other activity
· Activate and set your initial PIN on your HSA or Health & Benefits debit cards
Navigate your day-to-day health care needs
· If enabled by your employer, search for in-network medical providers close to your location
· Scan a product’s barcode to help find out if it’s a qualified medical expense for your Fidelity HSA or FSAs
The Fidelity Health app is available to people who enroll in their employer-sponsored health benefits through Fidelity or have an HSA with Fidelity. The features and functionality will vary based on the relationship between you, your employer (if applicable), and Fidelity. You can use your current Fidelity NetBenefits® or Fidelity.com login information to access Fidelity Health. Fidelity Health and the Fidelity Health logo are registered service marks of FMR LLC. Images are for illustrative purposes only.

Employees can then easily create, submit, and approve expense reports on-the-go from the app.
*Empower your employees to efficiently manage their expenses from anywhere
*Make paper receipts a thing of the past and simplify the expense experience for all
*Decrease manual data entry, improve data accuracy, and reduce errors
*Get a timely view of spend and gain insights into expense trends faster
ABOUT EMBURSE
Over 12 million professionals in 200 countries trust our platform, from global enterprises to mid-sized businesses and public sector organizations to nonprofits. With Emburse, finance teams eliminate busy work to regain the freedom to lead, grow, and shape the future of their business. Whether you're a CFO seeking financial control, a travel manager optimizing spend, or a busy employee submitting expenses on the go, Emburse simplifies expense management, travel booking, invoicing, and payments so organizations can drive efficiency and focus on strategic growth.

Rev your engine and race to survive in Dead Ahead, a legendary game where high-speed motorcycle racing meets relentless zombie obstacles. Navigate through urban chaos and deserted highwa
bluejetty:00024704:ios.description:
Dead Ahead: The Ultimate Motorcycle Racing Challenge
Rev your engine and race to survive in Dead Ahead, a legendary game where high-speed motorcycle racing meets relentless zombie obstacles. Navigate through urban chaos and deserted highways, dodging the undead as you push your bike to its limits.
PEDAL TO THE METAL
Master the art of motorcycle racing as you weave through abandoned cars and evade swarms of zombies. Upgrade your bike in the Garage for superior speed and handling that keep you one step ahead of the undead.
FULL THROTTLE SURVIVAL
Racing is survival. With the throttle under your grip and the road unwinding ahead, each turn brings new challenges. Outpace the zombie horde, and don't let them catch you. It’s not just about speed—it’s about strategy.
RACE FOR YOUR LIFE
Endure the apocalypse and take on grueling missions that test your reflexes and speed. The faster you go, the safer you are—speed is your ally.
HIGH-OCTANE FEATURES
Intuitive motorbike controls offer a smooth, responsive racing experience.
Tackle dozens of levels where each race is a fight for survival against zombie barricades.
Choose from a wide selection of motorbikes, each customizable to suit your racing style.
ADRENALINE-PACKED RACING
Feel the adrenaline pump as you race against time and zombies. Every level challenges your speed and agility, demanding precision driving and quick reflexes.
THE RACE DOESN'T STOP
Whether you’re offline or online, the race goes on. Prepare your bike, plan your route, and thrash those zombies with speed. Racing in Dead Ahead is not just about reaching the finish line; it's about surviving the journey.
JOIN THE THRILL
Gear up for the most thrilling ride of your life with Dead Ahead. Outsmart the undead, outpace your rivals, and discover the excitement in every race. Ready to prove you're the best? Jump on your bike and show the world what you're made of!

bluejetty:00018958:ios.description:
Welcome to Candy Match 3: Sweet Lands - a realm where every corner is filled with delightful candies, mesmerizing puzzles, and delectable challenges.
Unleash a World of Sweetness:
Delve into an enchanting universe bustling with colorful candies, mouth-watering chocolates, chewy marshmallows, and tangy lollipops. It's a paradise for puzzle lovers and candy aficionados alike!
Engaging Gameplay for Every Puzzle Lover:
- Match & Crush: Adapt your strategies to match and crush candies in intriguing configurations.
- Diverse Candy Levels: Traverse through honey-filled forests, caramel waterfalls, and chocolate-coated terrains.
- Unlock Powerful Boosters: Explode through obstacles with cake pops, activate sweet cascades with rainbow candies, and harness the magic of sugar-coated power-ups.
- Innovative Design & Graphics: Lose yourself in meticulously crafted levels with vibrant visuals and enticing candy designs.
Evolve Your Candy-Matching Skills:
Layered Challenges: Beyond basic matching, discover levels with deeper mechanics, layered objectives, and delectable challenges.
Strategic Gameplay: Plan your moves wisely! Every decision can lead to chain reactions, offering higher scores and more delightful rewards.
Essential Features for an Enhanced Experience:
- Endless Adventures: With over 1,000 unique levels, the fun never stops. Each level is a fresh puzzle waiting to be deciphered.
- Regular Updates: Dive into new worlds, fresh challenges, and innovative mechanics introduced regularly.
Quick Guide to Sweet Success:
Kickstart each level by understanding its core objective.
Strategically swipe and match to create sweet explosions.
Employ power-ups for those challenging puzzle pinch-points.
Celebrate each victory and gear up for the next candy conundrum!
Your journey through Candy Match 3: Sweet Lands promises a rollercoaster of emotions - from the joy of cracking a tough level to the anticipation of what lies ahead. Every swipe, match, and blast is a step closer to becoming the ultimate candy connoisseur.
Share Your Thoughts!
Passionate about our game? We are fervent about enhancing your experience. Drop a review, and let's make your candy-filled adventure even sweeter!

bluejetty:00019314:ios.summary: New twist in classic "Falling Blocks" game. Play with challenging 5 (penta) brick figures instead of classic 4 (tetris). Manipulate the pieces to form a horizontal lines without gaps. Embark on a journey of timeless puzzle-solving fun with
bluejetty:00019314:ios.description:
New twist in classic "Falling Blocks" game. Play with challenging 5 (penta) brick figures instead of classic 4 (tetris). Manipulate the pieces to form a horizontal lines without gaps. Embark on a journey of timeless puzzle-solving fun with Pentix Nova, the ultimate rendition of the classic block-stacking game! Immerse yourself in the iconic “Falling Blocks” experience reimagined for the modern era, featuring stunning graphics, intuitive controls, and a host of exciting new features. Whether you're a seasoned pro or a newcomer to the world of block puzzles, Pentix Nova offers a captivating and challenging gameplay experience that will keep you hooked for hours on end.
=== Key Features ===
- Classic Gameplay with a Modern Twist: Rediscover the addictive joy of fitting tetrominoes and pentaminoes together to clear lines. Pentix Nova stays true to the beloved original while introducing new features and enhancements that elevate the gameplay to a whole new level.
- Endless Challenge Mode: Test your “falling blocks” skills in the relentless Endless Challenge mode. How long can you keep up with the ever-increasing speed and complexity? Compete against yourself and friends to achieve the highest score and claim the title of Pentix Nova.
- Campaign and Adventure Modes: Embark on a thrilling journey through a series of meticulously crafted levels in our exclusive Campaign Mode. Solve puzzles, overcome obstacles, and progress through a variety of unique challenges that will test your Pentix skills to the max. Each level is a new opportunity to showcase your strategic prowess and unlock rewards. Can you conquer them all?
- Global Multiplayer Mode: Connect with falling blocks genre enthusiasts worldwide in the exhilarating multiplayer mode. Compete in real-time matches, showcase your skills, and rise through the ranks to become the ultimate Pentix.
- Achievements and Leaderboards: Track your progress and compete with players from around the world. Unlock a variety of achievements as you master different aspects of the game. Climb the leaderboards to prove that you're the ultimate Pentix champion.
- Visually Stunning Graphics: Immerse yourself in a visually captivating world where vibrant colors and dynamic animations bring the classic falling blocks to life. Experience a feast for the eyes as you play through different themes and backgrounds.
- Epic Soundtrack: Enjoy the timeless classic tunes that have become synonymous with the game. Let the catchy melodies and immersive sound effects enhance your gaming experience and keep you in the zone as you tackle challenging levels.
- Intuitive Controls: Effortlessly control the falling tetriminoes and pentiminoes with easy-to-master swipe and tap gestures. Whether you're a casual player or a hardcore enthusiast, Pentix Nova ensures a smooth and enjoyable gameplay experience for everyone.
Are you ready to take on the challenge and become a Pentix? Download now and experience the timeless joy of stacking blocks in this modern and feature-packed version of the classic falling blocks game!

bluejetty:00027302:ios.description:
Say hello to Hearing Remote and experience a life where hearing is not just about what you hear but how you hear it. 
With quick and seamless navigation, the Hearing Remote app allows you to easily and discretely make the adjustments you need in the moment. From volume control to programs that you can select and customize, you choose how to personalize your experience! 
Feel confident in your hearing journey knowing that Hearing Remote provides you with: 
Everyday Support 
Confidently manage the day-to-day maintenance of your hearing aids with the help of Tutor, your personalized virtual hearing aid guide that delivers helpful tips, reminders and advice straight to your smartphone. 
Connected Care 
Receive remote adjustments from your hearing care provider to fine tune your listening experience, without having to wait for your next appointment. 
Lifestyle Data 
Feel empowered with lifestyle data that monitors your wearing time, time spent in different listening environments and your level of physical activity. 
Find my Devices 
Gain peace of mind knowing you can track down misplaced hearing aids with Find my Devices.

bluejetty:00035394:ios.summary:

Please see Uses and Important Safety Information for SKYRIZI (risankizumab-rzaa) at www.skyr
bluejetty:00035394:ios.description:
Please see Uses and Important Safety Information including BOXED WARNING for RINVOQ (upadacitinib) at www.rinvoq.com/important-safety-information.
Please see Uses and Important Safety Information for SKYRIZI (risankizumab-rzaa) at www.skyrizi.com/important-safety-information.
Please see the Full Prescribing Information for RINVOQ at www.rxabbvie.com/pdf/rinvoq_pi.pdf and SKYRIZI at www.rxabbvie.com/pdf/skyrizi_pi.pdf.
The Complete App features personalized treatment logging, symptom logging, and medication reminders to support and encourage you throughout treatment.
CUSTOMIZED INJECTION LOGGING & TRAINING FOR SKYRIZI PATIENTS
· Keep track of when and where you inject SKYRIZI on your body.
· View your injection history by date with details. Tap on a specific date to see injection times, sites, and notes. 
· Personalize how you rotate injection sites in a chronological order. 
· Use in-app videos, training kits, and more to review injection training from your doctor.
DOSE TRACKING FOR RINVOQ PATIENTS
· Make it easier to stick to your treatment plan and track treatment with the RINVOQ dose tracker.
DOSE REMINDERS & MEDICATION TRACKERS
· Tools to help manage your medication through this free app. Set reminders and enable push notifications so you never miss a dose.
CALENDAR
· View your treatment schedule, symptom history, and a body diagram of injection locations.
SYMPTOM TRACKING
· Keep a log of your symptoms to discuss at your next doctor visit. This may help you have more productive discussions about your treatment.
ACCESS MORE COMPLETE RESOURCES
· Request resources to support you throughout treatment, like a Savings Card that may help eligible patients lower prescription cost†.
· Connect with an Ambassador*, there to provide support and help answer questions. 
· Submit receipts for reimbursement on eligible out-of-pocket expenses through the Complete Prescription Rebate†.
†Please see the Savings Card Terms & Conditions for RINVOQ at www.rinvoq.com/resources/save-on-rinvoq-costs#saving-cards-t-m and SKYRIZI at https://www.skyrizi.com/skyrizi-complete/save-on-skyrizi-costs#tandcs.
*Ambassadors are provided by AbbVie and do not work under the direction of your health care professional (HCP) or give medical advice. They are trained to direct patients to their HCP for treatment-related advice, including further referrals.
Additional Information
If you’re taking SKYRIZI or RINVOQ, you may want help starting and staying on track with your treatment plan. The Complete App can help by providing resources that allow you to set reminders, track symptoms, and create personal goals that can support and encourage you throughout your treatment journey. 
If you have any questions or concerns with the Complete App, or you need to report medication side effects or adverse events, call 1.866.SKYRIZI (1.866.759.7494) for SKYRIZI and 1-800-2RINVOQ (1-800-274-6867) for RINVOQ.
This app is intended for the exclusive use of U.S. residents 18 years of age and older. The Complete App is not intended to provide treatment decisions or replace the care and advice of a licensed healthcare provider. All medical analysis and treatment plans should be performed by a licensed healthcare provider.
US-MULT-260568

bluejetty:00024201:ios.summary: iBreathe is a simple yet powerful app to guide you through deep breathing exercises and breathwork. Whether you are struggling with stress, anxiety, insomnia, or are trying to meditate and relax, iBreathe provides an easy-to-use beautifully
bluejetty:00024201:ios.description:
iBreathe is a simple yet powerful app to guide you through deep breathing exercises and breathwork. Whether you are struggling with stress, anxiety, insomnia, or are trying to meditate and relax, iBreathe provides an easy-to-use beautifully designed user interface. Unlike other apps, iBreathe is designed with simplicity in mind and does not contain any bloat or clutter.
Core features:
+ Simple & easy to use interface
+ Pre-defined exercises specifically designed to help with sleep, stress, and anxiety
+ Create your own fully customizable breathing exercises
+ Create reminders to remind you to breathe throughout the day
+ Syncs with Apple Health to track Mindful Minutes
+ Learn about the benefits of deep breathing and view recommended literature by authors like James Nestor and Wim Hof
+ iCloud sync across all your Apple devices
+ Apple Watch app for breathing on the go
+ Lock screen widget for quick access to iBreathe
iBreathe is available on all Apple platforms:
iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Mac (Apple Silicon), Apple TV, and Vision Pro.

bluejetty:00013875:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00013875:ios.description:
Install Bluecrew and join our team of more than 900,000 Crew Members who have worked over 1 million shifts!
Bluecrew is more than just a job app. Our technology puts you in control by matching you with short and long-term, part-time and full-time hourly job assignments and letting you choose the ones that fit your life. Plus, when you work for Bluecrew, you are a W-2 employee, protected with benefits like overtime, sick days, and workers' comp. 
How do I join Bluecrew?
- Download the Bluecrew app and sign up
- Choose a job that fits your preferences, skills and schedule
- Complete a one-time onboarding to become an eligible worker - we call our workers Crew Members!
- Work and get paid weekly. And get paid early with On-Demand Pay, which allows you to access your weekly earnings days before payday
Why work with Bluecrew?
*Choose Work in Real-Time
Browse our network of diverse job assignments - including work in warehouses, retail, food service, stadiums, events, and more - then choose a shift schedule and get confirmed immediately.
*Set Your Own Schedule
Job assignments come straight to your phone, complete with wage, location, job description and more. Select the work you want and build your own schedule - all in the app.
*Get W-2 Status Immediately
When you work with Bluecrew, you are a W-2 employee of Bluecrew. Unlike typical “gig work” apps where you are a contractor, Bluecrew offers all of the protections and benefits that come with being W-2, like overtime, sick days, workers' comp and access to insurance.
What are you waiting for? Become a Bluecrew Crew Member to start working and earning!
To learn more about the Bluecrew team, our mission, and what we're up to, visit https://www.bluecrewjobs.com.
Have more questions? Please email us at support@bluecrewjobs.com.

- Fun puzzles for everyone
- A new puzzle every day, 365 days a year
- Hints to get you past those obscure words
- Bragging rights for your ever-improving general knowledge and vocabulary
What are you waiting for? Download Crossword Explorer+ right now, join thousands of crossword enthusiasts and see why everyone is hooked! 
Write back to us with any issues or suggestions, we are all ears!

bluejetty:00014481:ios.description:
The MyHotelTeam® mobile application provides on the go access to view current schedules, time cards, and time off requests.
HOME PAGE
Immediately see your schedule for today and the next three days.
SCHEDULE
View your schedule for the week as soon as it’s published by the hotel.
TIMECARD
View the current week’s daily hours and a summary of hours so far. Pay Rate items, like wages and tips, are not included. 
TIME OFF
Make requests for time off as soon as you know you need off. View any pending, approved, and denied requests.
AVAILABILITY
Input requests for Availability preferences as you know your ongoing schedule availability. 
Note: Some hotels choose to remove the Timecard, Time Off, or Availability pages from their employee access. If you have any questions about this, ask your manager or supervisor.
MyHotelTeam® is operated by Hotel Effectiveness®– the leader in labor management solutions designed exclusively for hotels.

bluejetty:00036200:ios.description:
Biblical offers gentle, personalized, Scripture-grounded guidance for daily life.
See a personalized Verse of the Day on your Lock Screen, then open the AI Bible chat with one tap for context, clarity, and practical next steps. Read, listen, and ask anything to build a simple rhythm of devotional, prayer, and study that fits your pace.
NEW: Daily Verse and Chat Widgets for Lock Screen
• See a fresh, personalized verse on your Lock Screen
• Open Bible chat with one tap from the widget
• Receive quick insights that invite prayer and reflection for your day
Highlights
• Meaningful conversations with guidance shaped to your questions
• Personalized study plans with clear step-by-step routes tailored to your goals
• Daily devotional and prayer to reflect and apply
• Multiple Bible Versions: NIV, ESV, CSB, NRSVUE and NRSVA, NKJV, Amplified, Reina Valera 1960, and more
• Audio Bible: Listen on the go and hear God’s Word wherever you are
• Quick Verse Finder: Discover context, themes, and meaning behind passages
• On-demand Biblical support for what you are facing now, such as anxiety, hope, relationships, and decision making
• Interactive study chats that meet your level, from beginner to deep dive
• Progress Tracker: Goals, reminders, widgets, and streaks to help you stay consistent
• Chat with Biblical characters for Scripture-grounded perspectives that spark insight
• Optional prayer journal to capture prayers, insights, and answered prayers
How It Works
• Choose a starting point such as today’s verse, a study plan, or any question.
• Chat with Bible for context, explanation, and practical application.
• Build a sustainable habit with widgets, reminders, and progress tracking.
Why Biblical
Instant access, conversational study, and clear next steps make time in the Word simple, consistent, meaningful, and personal.
FAQ
- What is Biblical?
- A conversation-first Bible app with an AI companion that makes Scripture easy to access, understand, and apply.
- How quickly will I see value?
- Many users feel encouraged after their first verse and chat. Deeper growth comes from a few focused minutes each day.
- Do I need prior Bible knowledge?
- No. Ask anything. Biblical explains context, themes, and application in plain English.
- Which translations are included?
- Popular versions such as NIV, ESV, CSB, NRSVUE and NRSV

bluejetty:00015965:ios.description:
"Duncan Price is paranoid," they used to say. He's just the local nut.
They used to say a lot of things about him.
Now they don't say anything.
Because they're dead.
You awaken in what appears to be your father's abandoned bunker with no idea how you got there. Last night was wild... but not that wild.
A familiar voice crackles over an old two-way radio. It's your sister. She tells you you've been locked inside for your own safety.
She's trapped too.
If you want to save her, you'll need to escape the bunker, uncover the truth behind your family's past, solve ingenious puzzles, and discover what happened before you're...
...all that remains.
Explore every corner, collect useful items, uncover hidden clues, and unravel a chilling mystery in this immersive first-person escape room adventure from Glitch Games.

bluejetty:00030149:ios.name: Rivercast: River Levels USA
bluejetty:00030149:ios.summary:
Whether you're a boater, property owner, fisherman, paddler, whitewater rafter, or someone who works or lives near the water, Rivercast® makes it easy to see exactly what's happening on the rivers that matter to you.
Rivercast includes:
•
bluejetty:00030149:ios.description:
Whether you're a boater, property owner, fisherman, paddler, whitewater rafter, or someone who works or lives near the water, Rivercast® makes it easy to see exactly what's happening on the rivers that matter to you.
Rivercast includes:
• Over 12,000 active gauges across USA
• Official flood warnings and alerts from the National Weather Service
• River stage height in feet
• River flow rate in CFS (when available)
• Color indicators showing when a river is normal, rising, or flooding
• Current observations and recent history
• Custom river level alerts when a river reaches your chosen level (Premium feature)
• NOAA river forecasts (when available)
• Interactive Map showing all nearby river gauges
• Search by waterway name, state, or NOAA 5-digit station ID
• Interactive Graphs with pinch-to-zoom and pan
• Add your own reference lines to graphs for landmarks or safety levels
• Favorites list for quick access to your key locations
• Share graphs via iMessage, Email, Facebook, and more
• Full Dark Mode support
• Companion Apple Watch app to monitor your favorites (Premium feature)
• Home Screen, Lock Screen, and StandBy Mode Widgets to monitor your favorites
Rivercast’s map not only shows where gauges are located, but color-codes them to indicate whether each station is at normal levels, approaching flood stage, or above flood stage.
Tap any location to view the latest observations or open an interactive graph for detailed trends. Pinch or drag to zoom and pan, or tap and hold for precise readings using the crosshair tool.
Customize your hydrographs with personal level markers for bridges, sandbars, rocks, or safe navigation levels. Add favorite gauges for quick monitoring anytime.
Rivercast uses official NOAA observation and forecast data and requires an internet connection for data access. Data is displayed in feet or cubic feet per second (CFS) when available, always shown in your local time.
A trusted tool for boaters, fishermen, property owners, paddlers, scientists, and marine professionals who need clear, reliable river information.
River gauges reported are USA only.
We take our accuracy seriously!
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * 
Some Frequently Asked Questions:
Where does Rivercast get its data?
This app uses NOAA sources for its raw data for our custom graphing and mapping solutions. Some locations available only from other agencies (such as USGS) may not appear in this app.
Why does Rivercast sometimes show slightly different flow data (CFS) than USGS?
CFS is a calculated estimate derived from stage height. NOAA and USGS may sometimes use different data models, so results can vary slightly—usually within a few percent. Stage height should always be identical between NOAA and USGS, and designated flood stages are usually based on height in feet.
Why does Rivercast only show observations, but not forecasts, for my river?
NOAA provides forecasts for many, but not all, monitored rivers. Some forecasts are seasonal or only issued during high-water events.
My river gauge was there yesterday, but it’s gone today. Why?
River gauges occasionally have technical issues transmitting data or may even be washed out during flooding. Some are also seasonal. NOAA typically restores data within a few days or weeks.
Can you add location XYZ to your app?
We wish we could! If NOAA doesn’t report data for that location, we unfortunately can’t include it. Rivercast displays all stations that NOAA provides for public use.
For more information, visit www.RivercastApp.com
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula
Disclaimer: Rivercast is not affiliated with or endorsed by NOAA, USGS, or any other government entity.
Rivercast

bluejetty:00016936:ios.description:
Guess the word from the picture in this fun and addictive quiz game!
Pic Quiz combines picture puzzles, photo trivia and logo challenges into one exciting game. Reveal the image, identify what it shows and earn rewards.
With hundreds of images and a huge variety of themed packs, there is always something new to discover. Every pack starts easy and becomes more challenging as you progress.
FEATURES
* Hundreds of picture puzzles and photo challenges
* Logo quiz packs featuring famous brands
* Animal, geography and world trivia packs
* Maps, countries and famous landmarks
* Food, plants and nature challenges
* History, anatomy and musical instrument packs
* Smart pack browser for easy navigation
* Eight different picture reveal styles
* Rewards for completing packs
* Daily Challenge each day to test yourself against others
* Compete with others in a league system with weekly promotions/relegations (optional)
* Play in portrait or landscape mode
* Optimized for phones and tablets
* Play in English or choose from 46 additional languages
POPULAR CATEGORIES
* Animals
* Logos and Brands
* Countries and Geography
* Famous Landmarks
* Dog Breeds
* Birds and Mammals
* Fruit and Vegetables
* Desserts
* Fashion
* Sports
* Musical Instruments
* Medieval History
* Plants and Flowers
* Buildings
* Professions
* Anatomy
* Pets
* Beaches
* Gardens
Whether you enjoy word games, guessing games, trivia games or family puzzle games, Pic Quiz offers hours of entertainment for players of all ages.
Improve your vocabulary, spelling and general knowledge while exploring hundreds of beautiful images and challenging picture puzzles.
Easy to learn and fun to master, Pic Quiz is perfect for anyone who loves quiz games, brain teasers and discovering new topics.

bluejetty:00026944:ios.description:
Welcome to Penny Finder! Where like-minded, savings savvy, penny pinching people come to find the latest and greatest penny finds from Dollar General*!
WE NOW HAVE OVER 3700+ VERIFIED PENNY ITEMS AND COUNTING!
Join the THOUSANDS of other Penny Finders!
Penny Finder crowdsources information from our users and catalogs items into a database...AKA we put them in a nice searchable table! You can:
- Scan a barcode and the app will tell you if an item is a penny based on other user's discoveries (This app is not a Price Scanner, it's a Penny Scanner)
- OFFLINE MODE: Our app will still work even if you have no internet, just make sure you have downloaded the list at least once.
- Add your own Penny Items to the list using our Penny Scanner!
- Post your amazing finds on our Haul Wall!
- Most Recent Penny Finds are highlighted in green and at the top
- You can flag penny items that you know are full price to have them removed.
- You can add Penny Items to your favorites for quick viewing later.
WHAT WE ASSUME YOU KNOW BEFORE YOU DOWNLOAD:
We assume that you know what penny items are.
We assume you know what store this app is for.
We assume that you know that UPC codes are very important and critical to finding the correct penny items. (you shouldn't penny shop based off only images).
WE CANNOT GUARANTEE THAT THE STORES YOU VISIT WILL HAVE PENNY ITEMS.
THIS APP IS NOT A PRICE SCANNER, it's a Penny Scanner.
***The Penny Scanner's performance is based on the frame rate of your camera on your device. (Which means older devices such as an iPhone 4S and older model iPods/iPads will scan slower using the Penny Scanner than new devices that have considerably better cameras.)
*PENNY FINDER IS NOT ASSOCIATED, AFFILIATED, SPONSORED BY, OR ENDORSED BY DOLLAR GENERAL.

bluejetty:00033754:ios.name: Just Survival Multiplayer
bluejetty:00033754:ios.summary:
Build your base, fight real players and raid rival compounds in an online open-world survival experience.
Just Survival Multiplayer drops you into a hostile wilderness where resources are valuable, wildlife is dangerous and every survivor
bluejetty:00033754:ios.description:
Build your base, fight real players and raid rival compounds in an online open-world survival experience.
Just Survival Multiplayer drops you into a hostile wilderness where resources are valuable, wildlife is dangerous and every survivor you meet could become an ally—or your next enemy.
BUILD & DEFEND YOUR BASE
Gather wood, stone, metal and other resources to build your own shelter.
Start small and expand your home into a fortified base with storage, stronger structures and defenses designed to protect the gear and supplies you have collected.
Other players are building too, so be ready to defend what is yours.
ONLINE PvP & BASE RAIDS
Fight real players in first-person combat and compete for valuable resources, territory and loot.
Scout rival compounds, prepare your equipment and launch raids against enemy bases. Break through their defenses and search for weapons, resources and valuable supplies.
Every encounter can change quickly. Decide when to fight, when to retreat and which survivors you can trust.
PLAY SOLO OR FORM A CLAN
Survive on your own or team up with friends.
Create a clan, gather resources together, build larger bases and defend your territory as a group.
Coordinate raids against rival survivors and work together to survive in a dangerous multiplayer world.
CRAFT WEAPONS & EQUIPMENT
Turn gathered resources into useful tools, weapons, armor and survival equipment.
Improve your gear as you progress and prepare for increasingly dangerous encounters with players and wildlife.
SURVIVE THE OPEN WORLD
Explore forests, dangerous locations and radiation zones while managing hunger, thirst and health.
Leaving the safety of your base always carries risk. Valuable resources may be waiting beyond the next hill, but another survivor may be waiting too.
HUNT & FACE WILDLIFE
Wolves, bears, boars and other animals roam the wilderness.
Hunt for food and useful materials while protecting yourself from dangerous predators.
FEATURES
• Online multiplayer survival
• Real-player PvP combat
• First-person shooter gameplay
• Base building and defenses
• Player base raiding
• Clan and cooperative gameplay
• Resource gathering and crafting
• Weapons, armor and survival equipment
• Open-world exploration
• Radiation zones
• Wildlife and hunting
• Hunger, thirst and health survival
• PvP and PvE threats
Build your territory, protect your loot and fight to survive in Just Survival Multiplayer.

bluejetty:00025829:ios.summary:

With Newgrain's catalog of 300+ fi
bluejetty:00025829:ios.description:
Film photographers, welcome home. Newgrain is a platform dedicated to analog photography. Get inspired by thousands of film photos in a clean, distraction-free space. No ads. No videos. Just photography. 
With Newgrain's catalog of 300+ film stocks, browse through different films and learn about their grain, exposure latitude, and contrast, while discovering thousands of sample images. Perfect to find your next film to shoot film.
SHARE YOUR WORK
You've put care and effort into making a beautiful photo. It deserves more recognition than what algorithms will give it. With Newgrain, your work will be seen by hundreds of photographers thanks to our community-wide, chronological feed... and you may get featured in our Newgrain Picks!
QUALITY > QUANTITY
Forget about chasing likes or followers. On Newgrain, the focus is truly on your art. We've removed distractions and metrics, because photography shouldn't be a popularity contest – it should just be enjoyed as it is.
ADVANCED METADATA
Ever wonder how a photographer achieves certain results? 
"Is that 35mm or 120? Have they pushed the film? Which film scanner have they used?"
On Newgrain, posts are tagged with:
- Equipment: film stock, format, camera, lens, lab, scanner
- Techniques: Push / Pull, developing method, expired film
HOME TO THE FILM COMMUNITY
Over 4000 photographers around the world have joined us – and it's just the beginning. Newgrain is the digital hub for the film photography world, connecting photographers, labs, and manufacturers.
JOIN THE ANALOG RENAISSANCE
Whether you've been shooting film for decades or just got your hands on your first disposable camera, you'll find a place in Newgrain's community of photographers.
More information:
Privacy Policy: https://newgrain.framer.website/privacy-policy
Terms of Use / License agreement: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/"

bluejetty:00035181:ios.summary: Truth or Dare: Fun Spin Bottle is a fun app designed to bring excitement to any occasion, whether you're with your partner or a group of friends. The game is easy to use, with different modes and custom options that let you enjoy your time
bluejetty:00035181:ios.description:
Truth or Dare: Fun Spin Bottle is a fun app designed to bring excitement to any occasion, whether you're with your partner or a group of friends. The game is easy to use, with different modes and custom options that let you enjoy your time to the fullest.
Keyfeature of the Truth or Dare games app:

وهو مصحف جديد تتلوا من خلاله القرآن الكريم ، و تجد في كل آية منه وقفات متنوعه ، تبحر بها إلى كنوز القران وتنهل
bluejetty:00039465:ios.description:
بفكرة إبداعية غير مسبوقة ، وبجهد ضخم بلغ عشرات الآلاف من ساعات العمل المتواصلة ،
يسرنا ان نقدم لكم تطبيق ( تدارس القرآن ) : 
وهو مصحف جديد تتلوا من خلاله القرآن الكريم ، و تجد في كل آية منه وقفات متنوعه ، تبحر بها إلى كنوز القران وتنهل من لآلئ خيراته ، وذلك من خلال أقسام متعدده تحتوي على أكثر من مائة ألف وقفة مقسمة كالتالي : 
١- تدبرات وتأملات قرآنية منوعه ما بين نصية وجرافيك ومقاطع يوتيوب مع امكانية المستخدم كتابة تدبراته الخاصة والتفاعل مع الوقفات الاخرى.
٢- تفسير للقرآن الكريم بمقاطع مرئية ومسموعة لكبار المشايخ المعاصرين مثل ابن باز وابن عثيمين والشنقيطي والشعراوي ، وغيرهم الكثير الكثير .
٣- الأسرار البلاغية في الآية : الآلاف من الاسرار البلاغية التي استنبطها العلماء وقدمناها بعدة اشكال مرئية ومسموعة ومكتوبة .
٤- تذكر وإعتبار : قسم منوع فيه الإعجاز العلمي في القران ، وقصص مع الآيه ، وكلمات العلماء عنها ، وغيره من علوم الآية وكنوزها .
٥- الأحكام الفقهية والأداب التي تحدثت عنها الآية : شرح وافي للاحكام الفقهية في الايات يقدمها علماء اجلاء مثل الشيخ محمد ابن عثيمين والشيخ سعد الشثري وغيرهم .
٦- إقتراحات العمل بالآية : جمعنا لك العديد من الأعمال التي تم إقتراحها ، لكي يجمع القارئ بين العلم والعمل بالآية .
٧- الدعاء والمناجاة : جمعنا أدعية من مفهوم الآية تدعو بها عند تلاوتك لها ، فقد كان الرسول صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا مر بآية رحمه سأل وإذا مر بأية عذاب تعوذ وإذا مر بآية تسبيح سبح .
٨- التساؤلات : اجابات عن بعض الاسئلة التي تتبادر إلى الذهن عند تلاوة الآيات أجاب عنها هيئة كبار العلماء والشيخ عبدالعزيز بن باز والشيخ محمد بن عثيمين ومن مجلة البحوث العلمية وغيرهم .
٩- قسم المتشابه : بعض القواعد والأفكار والطرق لضبط الحفظ وإتقانه . 
و الميزة الرئيسية في التطبيق أنه مصحف تفاعلي يستطيع مستخدمه إدراج تدبراته وتساؤلاته و وقفاته المتنوعه ، ويعلق على الوقفات الموجودة ويضع لها إعجاب وعدم إعجاب ، في جو تفاعلي نشط .
وكذلك من مميزات التطبيق الرائعة :
* بطريقة برمجية إبداعية : يمكنك من خلال التطبيق إرسال أي تدبر : على شكل لوحة جرافيك رائعة ، تختار خلفيتها من صور جميله ادرجناها في التطبيق ، والأجمل أنك تستطيع ان تختار الخلفية من ألبوم الصور في جوالك أو تلتقطها بكاميرا الجوال مباشرة .
* وكذلك جمعنا أكثر من 2500 لوحة جرافيك تدبريه جميله تجدها مدرجه في كل آية تخصها .
* حرصا منا على نشر العلم : تستطيع تصدير وقفات آية أو سورة على شكل ملف pdf أو ملف word او تستعرضها بشكل مرتب في المتصفح . ( حد أقصى ١٠ آيات لملفات pdf ، وعدد لا محدود للبقية )
* بإمكانك -تصفح وقفات أي عالم او شيخ او متدبر ، وذلك بالضغط مطولا على إسم صاحب الوقفة ، كما يمكنك متابعة جديده ، عندما تقوم بتفضيله في قائمة المصادر المفضلة .
* ميزة البحث في الوقفات .
* ميزة تفضيل وقفة معينة لكي ترجع لها لاحقا.
* ٢٧ كتاب لتفسير القرآن الكريم ، بالإضافة لروابط مباشرة لتفسير الدرر السنية الرائع .
* مميزات أخرى : مثل الورد اليومي - الوضع الليلي - تغيير ألوان الخط والخلفية - إضافة ملاحظة للآية - وضع علامة للرجوع للصفحة - تكبير خط الوقفات وتصغيره ، وغيرها من المميزات الرائعة .
ولدعم التطبيق أنشأنا قناة في اليوتيوب قمنا فيها بمونتاج أكثر من ٢٢٠٠ مقطع في التفسير والتدبر .
سألين الله ان يجعل هذا التطبيق معين للناس على تدارس القران وتدبره وأن يشملنا جميعا قول الرسول صلى الله عليه وسلم ( مَا اجْتَمَعَ قَوْمٌ فِي بَيْتٍ مِنْ بُيُوتِ اللَّهِ يَتْلُونَ كِتَابَ اللَّهِ وَيَتَدَارَسُونَهُ بَيْنَهُمْ إِلَّا نَزَلَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّكِينَةُ وَغَشِيَتْهُمُ الرَّحْمَةُ وَحَفَّتْهُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَذَكَرَهُمُ اللَّهُ فِيمَنْ عِنْدَهُ ) .

bluejetty:00026250:ios.description:
BINAURAL BEATS FOR FOCUS, SLEEP & MEDITATION
Discover Brainwaves, an immersive collection of binaural beats, brainwave frequencies, Solfeggio sounds, isochronic tones and ambient soundscapes for focus, sleep, study, meditation and relaxation.
Explore Alpha, Beta, Theta, Delta, Gamma and 40 Hz brainwave sounds, together with frequency-based audio designed for different moments throughout your day.
Whether you're studying, working, meditating, relaxing or winding down before sleep, find a sound that fits your routine.
--- BINAURAL BEATS & BRAINWAVES ---
Explore binaural beats across different brainwave frequency ranges. Binaural beats use slightly different tones in each ear to create an immersive listening experience. Headphones are recommended.
Choose sounds for:
• Deep focus and concentration
• Study and productive work
• Sleep and nighttime relaxation
• Meditation and mindfulness
• Calm and quiet moments
--- BRAINWAVE FREQUENCIES ---
Explore different brainwave frequency ranges:
• Delta – Slow-frequency sounds for nighttime listening and relaxation
• Theta – Gentle sounds for meditation, mindfulness and quiet moments
• Alpha – Calming frequencies for relaxed focus
• Beta – Brainwave sounds for concentration and attentive listening
• Gamma – Fast-frequency sounds for focus and deep work
--- 40 HZ GAMMA & DEEP FOCUS ---
Explore dedicated 40 Hz Gamma sessions for focused listening while studying, reading, working or completing creative tasks.
Discover 40 Hz alongside Alpha, Beta and other brainwave sounds to create your preferred listening environment.
--- SLEEP & RELAXATION ---
Create a peaceful nighttime routine with binaural beats, Delta and Theta waves, ambient sounds and calming nature soundscapes.
Find relaxing audio for sleep routines, meditation, mindfulness and quiet moments when you're ready to unwind.
--- SOLFEGGIO FREQUENCIES ---
Explore a collection of Solfeggio and frequency-based sounds, including:
• 174 Hz
• 285 Hz
• 396 Hz
• 417 Hz
• 432 Hz
• 528 Hz
• 639 Hz
• 741 Hz
• 852 Hz
• 963 Hz
Discover different frequencies for meditation, relaxation, mindfulness and peaceful listening.
--- ISOCHRONIC TONES & AMBIENT SOUNDS ---
Explore isochronic tones, ambient music, nature sounds and frequency-based soundscapes for even more ways to personalize your listening experience.
--- FEATURES ---
• Binaural beats for focus, sleep, study and meditation
• Alpha, Beta, Theta, Delta and Gamma brainwave sounds
• Dedicated 40 Hz Gamma sessions
• Solfeggio frequencies
• 432 Hz and 528 Hz sounds
• Isochronic tones
• Ambient music and nature sounds
• Simple and intuitive playback controls
• Growing library of brainwave and frequency content
FIND YOUR FREQUENCY
From binaural beats and 40 Hz Gamma to Alpha, Theta and Delta waves, Solfeggio frequencies and isochronic tones, Brainwaves brings frequency-based sounds together in one place.
Choose your sound and create a listening routine for focus, study, sleep, meditation or relaxation.
--- SUBSCRIPTION ---
• Monthly, Yearly and Lifetime plans are available.
• Unlock access to premium frequencies, soundscapes and sound features.
• Some content is available for free.
--- DISCLAIMER ---
Brainwaves provides audio content for general wellness, relaxation, meditation and entertainment purposes only. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Individual experiences may vary.
