bluejetty:00040517:ios.name: Gusto TV
bluejetty:00040517:ios.summary: Welcome to the Gusto TV App! Gusto TV is the world's best food channel. From baking to barbeque to food culture and sustainability, our award-winning programming celebrates culture, diversity, and family in fun and innovative ways. Our show
bluejetty:00040517:ios.description:
Welcome to the Gusto TV App! Gusto TV is the world's best food channel. From baking to barbeque to food culture and sustainability, our award-winning programming celebrates culture, diversity, and family in fun and innovative ways. Our shows will make your mouth water and your tummy rumble. Food is the one true global language and Gusto TV speaks all dialects. Come eat the world with us!
FEATURED GUSTO TV SHOWS
Bonacini’s Italy: Italian cuisine is so much more than pizza and pasta – but there’s still lots of tasty pasta in Bonacini's Italy. Celebrity Chef Michael Bonacini cooks his way through 15 Italian regions, exploring the flavors and ingredients that make these areas unique.
Cook Like A Chef: Cook Like a Chef focuses on how to cook as opposed to what to cook. Featuring a group of innovative, talented young chefs, watch as they explore and explain the arcana of cooking techniques. Each episode centers on a single ingredient or theme, as prepared by an expert chef who shares tips, tricks, and cooking techniques.
Let’s Brunch: Let’s Brunch is a delightful cooking series dedicated to everyone’s favorite leisurely and decadent mid-morning meal. Hosted by Vanessa Gianfrancesco, Let’s Brunch showcases sweet and savory recipes, along with the occasional refreshing beverage or cozy latte.
Flour Power: Flour Power is a fun, stylish, and playful series that is all about sharing the love and joy of baking. Step back in time with our lovely host Jessica McGovern in her retro inspired kitchen. Celebrating an uncomplicated love of baking, Flour Power shows us that baking doesn’t have to be perfect or complex – you can mess up and it can still turn out great. Join Jessica and indulge in the whimsical dream of Flour Power, it will be the sweetest half-hour of your day!
One World Kitchen: One World Kitchen is a creative and high style cooking series featuring nine cuisines: Argentinian, Italian, Thai, Japanese, Indian, Lebanese, Vietnamese, Cantonese, and Greek. The young and vibrant hosts will captivate your audience by teaching them how to master the world’s hottest dishes and showing them age-old cooking secrets from their unique cultures.
Spencer’s BIG 30: Spencer’s BIG 30 is a fast-paced series featuring healthy, hearty meals for four that can be made by anyone in around 30 minutes, for around 30 dollars. Keeping the pace, while guiding us from prep to plate, Chef Spencer Watts gives his top tips and tricks for cutting down cooking time, without sacrificing flavor. To prove how efficient his meals are, he actually cooks the entire meal in one take and it’s always around 30 minutes. That’s right - no television tricks in this series! While the kitchen may get a little messy, Spencer’s process is natural, fun, and easy to follow.
The Wizard of Sauce: The Wizard of Sauce pulls back the curtain on the magical world of sauces. In each episode, Chef Kyle Crawford demystifies the often-intimidating methods of sauce preparation creating three recipes based on different sauce techniques. Each episode presents history, health, and kitchen tips related to the recipes and ingredients through three secondary AI-enabled character segments – played by Kyle himself. The Wizard of Sauce shows audiences that anyone can be a wizard in the kitchen!
VegHeadz: Dive into a world of unique and exciting veg-forward dishes with VegHeadz! Hosted by Chef Pino Di Cerbo, this captivating series takes veggies from side dish to center stage. VegHeadz focuses on making cooking with a variety of vegetables fun, unintimidating and surprising in the best way. With fun facts about plant-based diets and a ‘grain of the day’, get ready to uncover a whole new world of cuisine never thought possible!
 AND MANY MORE!

bluejetty:00016405:ios.name: Flight Simulator FlyWings 2017
bluejetty:00016405:ios.summary:
Flight Simulator 2017 FlyWings is finally here! It contains many improvements and the flight physics are perfect!
Enjoy a huge set of aircraft - 95 - and almost every air company! This is definitely the best flight simulator ever developed
bluejetty:00016405:ios.description:
Flight Simulator 2017 FlyWings is finally here! It contains many improvements and the flight physics are perfect!
Enjoy a huge set of aircraft - 95 - and almost every air company! This is definitely the best flight simulator ever developed for macOS!
Fly in more than +2000 missions, over +600 airports in 9 different cities around the world. Use our GPS tool to create your own routes.
The first flight simulation with all city’s buildings and houses, all the airports have fingers, terminal, hangar, and taxiway lines. Real light system on the runways, with PAPI lights and more!
The environment, scenario and 3D models are highly detailed, realistic air and ground traffic, change almost every simulation parameter, like visibility, temperature, turbulence, wind direction, all the weather conditions and hour of the flight. Fly in stormy weather, with lightings and heavy rain to test your skills!
All the aircraft included in the simulator have specific modifications and special features, you will be able to choose the best aircraft that fits your needs!
Aircraft features:
- Choose between airplanes, helicopters, jet fighters, aerobatic planes and more!
- Configure the model specification and family.
- Choose one of the dozens of airline companies to fly your plane.
- Configure fuel payload and weight.
- Control all flaps, trims, spoilers, gear and turn engines on or off.
- Very detailed 3D models of the planes.
- Turn all the light signals on or off (Strobe, Landing, Transponder etc).
- 9 different cameras.
- Autopilot with speed, altitude, vertical speed and heading. 
Scenario and environment features:
- +600 airports around the world
- All airports have taxiway lines
- All the cities have real buildings and houses
- All airports have landing and take off lights
- Audio settings
- New details
- Thousand+ miles in 9 cities:
 > New York
 > San Francisco
 > Chicago
 > Hawaii (enjoy the view of the volcanoes!)
 > Las Vegas
 > Los Angeles
 > Seattle
 > Washington D.C
 > Saint Martin
- Weather conditions and hour option to choose when to fly.
***** Don’t forget to rate us! *****
Give us your feedback! All the updates we will be releasing for this flight simulator in the next weeks depend a lot on what you tell us!Flight Simulator FlyWings 2017

bluejetty:00034134:ios.description:
The ultimate map for EV drivers — find ULTRA FAST charging stations around the world.
Whether you drive a Tesla, BYD, Hyundai, Ford, Volkswagen, Rivian, 
Kia or any other electric vehicle, this app helps you discover and 
navigate to the nearest fast charging stations on your route, 
anywhere in the world.
# Features
- Worldwide charging map: View thousands of fast charging stations from 
major networks — including Tesla Supercharger, BYD, Ionity and many 
more — on a single interactive map.
- Detailed station info: Check charging power, number of stalls, 
opening hours, network operator, plug types and vehicle compatibility.
- Smart filters: Filter stations by network, charging speed, plug type, 
or accessibility — including Tesla Superchargers equipped with Magic 
Dock or NACS connectors that are open to non-Tesla vehicles.
- Precise locations: Get exact addresses and GPS coordinates to plan 
your trips without hassle.
- Journey planner: Plan a route between two points and find every 
fast charger along the way.
- Send to your vehicle: Transfer a station's location directly to your 
Tesla's in-vehicle navigation, or open it in Apple Maps, Google Maps 
or Waze for quick navigation.
- Real-time updates: Stay informed about new stations and updates to 
existing ones, worldwide.
Never waste time searching for a charging station again. Download 
the app and hit the road with peace of mind!

This is an independent application. It is not affiliated with,

period. Subscriptions will automatically renew unless canceled at

apple-macos:6817253103.name: Pinto Notes: Notes & Lists
apple-macos:6817253103.description:
Pinto Notes is a simple notes app your AI can use.
It works like the notes app you already know, with folders, checklists, tables and photos. The difference is that ChatGPT and Claude can read and update your notes when you let them.
ASK YOUR AI, IT'S IN YOUR NOTES
• "Add oat milk to my groceries." It's on your phone a second later.
• "What did we decide about the Lisbon hotel?" Your AI reads the note and answers.
• "Turn this meeting into a checklist in Work." Done, on every device.
• Every line an AI changes is highlighted, with Undo next to it.
A NOTES APP FIRST
• Checklists that move ticked items to the bottom
• Headings, bullets, numbered lists and quotes
• Tables you edit cell by cell
• Photos, PDFs and files in your notes and folders
• Sub-notes that keep details one tap away
• Keep writing offline. Changes sync when you're back.
• Lock a note with a password and Face ID
ENCRYPTED
Your notes are encrypted on your iPhone and Mac before they sync. We keep a locked copy of your key, so signing in on a new device opens your notes. It also means we could open them if we had to, for example under a court order. An AI you connect reads the notes it asks for through our server. A note you share as a web page is readable by anyone with the link.
YOU DECIDE WHO GETS IN
• You approve every AI connection
• Disconnect an AI at any time
• Every change keeps the earlier version, so you can go back
• Share a note as a web page and stop sharing whenever you like
• Delete your account and everything in it from Settings
BRING YOUR NOTES
Import from Evernote, Google Keep, or Markdown and text files. On the Mac, import from Apple Notes in one step.
No ads and no tracking. Open source. 2 GB of storage.
Sign in with Apple, Google or email. Connecting ChatGPT or Claude needs your own account with that service.
Pinto Notes was called Amber Notes until October 2026.

apple-macos:946169237.name: Achilleus 3D Tactical Map
apple-macos:946169237.description:
Achilleus 3D Tactical Map turns your iPhone and iPad into a complete field mapping system: real 3D terrain, every common grid, drone control, patrols and video, an AR view, offline maps and a team network encrypted end to end, with no external server needed.
Built for soldiers and reservists, security teams, first responders, search and rescue, drone pilots and outdoor professionals.
DRONE CONTROL (GROUND STATION)
• Fly ArduPilot and PX4 multirotors from your map over Wi-Fi or a network: take off, Pause, Return, Land, Fly here, Orbit, Point the camera
• Missions with heights above the ground: waypoints, surveys, corridors, orbits and search patterns, checked for terrain, radio range and battery
• Listen-only by default, every move confirmed with a slide, MAVLink 2 signing, geofence
• Practice drones to train; QGroundControl and Mission Planner files; flight logs
DRONE PATROL
• Guard a site with several drones: draw the area or pick one of your shapes; along the edge, the whole area or watch points, each drone on its own part
• Alerts for people and vehicles with a snapshot, time and coordinates; the nearest drone goes to look
• Battery changes planned: a drone low on battery is relieved and its part covered
• Detections list with Go to and CSV; alerts to your team and TAK only if you choose
FLY WITHOUT GPS (DIGITAL INS)
• GPS jammed? The app keeps flying your ArduPilot or PX4 drone on an inertial estimate learned from how it leans and flies, with an honest circle of where it is
• Catches a spoofed GPS that jumps or lies, and tells the drone to drop it
• Fix it by tapping a landmark, or let map match find the camera's view on the satellite map
• Link lost too: a helper on the drone flies it home (ArduPilot). After landing, its own log gives the exact track
LIVE VIDEO FROM DRONES & CAMERAS
• Drones, ground stations and IP cameras beside the map (RTSP, UDP, HLS), placed from STANAG 4609 (KLV) or MAVLink with the camera's footprint
• Tap the video to mark that spot; detect and follow people and vehicles; your markers in the drone's picture
• ONVIF pan, tilt and zoom; recording with map data and replay
AR VIEW (AUGMENTED REALITY)
• Hold up your phone: markers, teammates, TAK users, drones and drawings in their real places in the camera picture, with distance and height
• North fine-tuned offline on a landmark or the skyline; 2× zoom; mark a point under the cross
3D TERRAIN & OFFLINE MAPS
• Real terrain in 3D; satellite, topographic and street maps, or your own XYZ, WMTS and WMS sources
• Download areas and keep working without signal; red night mode
COORDINATES & GRIDS
• MGRS, UTM, Lat/Lon, British and Indian grids, in WGS 84, ED50 and other datums
• Convert one point or a whole list; Go to any position
MEASURE & ANALYSE
• Distance and bearing in mils or degrees; elevation profiles and slope
• Line of sight and viewshed; the highest and lowest points of an area; KMZ export
MARKERS, DRAWINGS & TACTICAL GRAPHICS
• MIL-STD-2525D symbols, flags or your own icons, with photos, range rings and layers
• Lines, routes and areas; operation plans with task graphics; KML, KMZ and GPX
NAVIGATE & RECORD
• Walk or drive to any point; record GPS tracks and share your location
ENCRYPTED TEAM NETWORK & TAK
• Wi-Fi, LAN or internet, through a server any device runs or in Mesh mode with no server; encrypted end to end (AES-256) with a team password
• Chat, voice messages and spoken team orders
• ATAK, WinTAK and iTAK users on your map and you on theirs, GeoChat
MADE FOR THE FIELD
• Portrait and landscape on iPhone and iPad, adjustable interface size
• No account needed: your data stays on your device
Achilleus is a planning and navigation aid. Always confirm critical positions with official maps and procedures, and follow your local drone rules.
Questions or ideas? Use Settings › Contact — we read every message.
